mapper.select: select f.id, f.document_id, d.team_id, d.title, d.visibility, d.author_id, d.status, d.view_count, d.like_count, d.favorite_count, f.created_at from favorite f left join document d on f.document_id = d.id where d.status != 0 AND ( d.visibility = 2 -- 公开文档，所有人可见 OR (d.visibility = 0 AND d.author_id = #{userId}) -- 私有文档，仅作者 OR (d.visibility = 1 AND d.team_id IN ( -- 团队文档，用户需在团队中 SELECT team_id FROM team_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} )) ) order by f.created_at desc
